overall_notes: This paper is misclassified as an NLG evaluation paper. It's actually about few-shot visual classification using language as privileged information during training. The language generation component (GRU decoder) serves only as an auxiliary training objective to regularize visual representations. The primary evaluation metric is classification accuracy, not language generation quality. The paper should not be included in an NLG evaluation survey.
